project_title: NETI Balkan Bäckerei - Premium Editorial Marketing Site & Admin Panel
archetype: ORGANIC & SWISS CRAFT HYBRID (Warm Amber Gold, Soft Cream, Deep Espresso Charcoal)
emotional_tone: Warm, authentic, artisanal, immaculate clarity, high-trust, welcoming German-Balkan bakery

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or Outfit (Display Serif / Crafted Warm Sans)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, or Inter (Clean, highly legible geometric sans with generous tracking)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For opening hours badges, admin status tags, contact metrics)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900 leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900
hierarchy.eyebrow_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-semibold text-amber-700 bg-amber-100/60 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-amber-200/50 inline-block

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x typical density). Use py-20 lg:py-32 for main home sections to allow natural breathing room.

bento_grid.mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID & CATEGORY TILES
bento_grid.structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8

header_and_navigation.style: Sticky / Fixed crystal glass header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 border-b border-stone-200/60 z-50 transition-all duration-300
header_and_navigation.desktop_nav: Visible brand logo (circular yellow wheat mark) + 4 main links (Unser Sortiment, Über Uns, Galerie, Standorts & Kontakt) + prominent CTA button 'Route planen'
header_and_navigation.mobile_nav: Accessible hamburger drawer with high-contrast text and instant tap actions ('Route planen', 'Jetzt anrufen')
header_and_navigation.anti_pattern_prevention: Never fully transparent header. Must maintain contrast against background scrolling images.

homepage_sections.description: Sticky nav with bakery logo, navigation links, and yellow route button

Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line headline reveal ('Täglich frischer Burek & Balkan-Spezialitäten in Ihrer Nähe'), warm dusk storefront photo, action buttons 'Unser Sortiment' and 'So finden Sie uns'
Slow organic drift marquee ribbon with low-contrast warm gold background: 'Frisch gebacken · Echter Balkan Burek · Pizza & Burger · Täglich warm serviert · NETI Balkan Bäckerei'
Short, honest intro about NETI Balkan Bäckerei (quality ingredients, freshly prepared daily, warm hospitalty - no fake history claims)
Interactive showcase for 5 confirmed categories: 1. Burek & pite, 2. Pizza, 3. Burger, 4. Brot & Brötchen, 5. Ćevapčići & Grill
High-fidelity gallery featuring provided photos (storefront at dusk, spiral burek, bakery interior) with smooth lightbox modal capability
Location & opening hours with clickable phone, email, address badge, and prominent Google Maps external link button 'Route planen'
Deep stone dark footer with Impressum, Datenschutz links, copyright, and admin login quick access

admin_panel_features.authentication: Protected login modal/page with mock or API auth state
editable_sections: Contact Info (Phone, Email, Address, Google Maps link)
Product Menu & Categories (Add/Edit items, prices, descriptions)
admin_panel_features.ux: Clean, cardless tabbed admin dashboard with toast notifications upon saving changes

motion_and_micro_interactions.hero_reveal: Staggered line reveal for hero headline and subtle parallax background scale on scroll
motion_and_micro_interactions.card_hover: Hover lift -translate-y-1.5 with glowing warm amber shadow transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease
motion_and_micro_interactions.buttons: Hover scale-102 active:scale-98 with clear color feedback

data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, admin save buttons, modals) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="hero-route-button", data-testid="admin-login-submit", data-testid="nav-impressum-link").
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all text is written in standard, natural, error-free German.
No fake tradition/history claims (e.g., avoid 'Seit 1890'). Focus on daily fresh quality, Balkan recipes, and warm hospitality.
Do NOT add third-party trackers, cookie banners, newsletter popups, embedded webshop checkout, or external map widgets.
Provide full legal compliance pages for Impressum and Datenschutz in proper German legal format.
Include full dynamic editing in the Owner Admin panel so edits persist to local storage / API state.
Always apply data-testid to every clickable or editable element.
